content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm programming a [product_name] connected to the local network. I'm wondering if it's possible to switch a contact on the [product_name] remotely using an iPhone app. Can anyone provide guidance on this? Thanks in advance.

As mentioned by [user_name] in a related topic, please use English in your posts. Within a local network, there should be no issue. You can utilize one of the available integrated web servers. Could you clarify what you mean by 'remotely via mobile phone'?
I would like to know if it's possible to create a mobile app that interacts with [product_name] via my phone, which is also connected to the local network.

No, that's not what I meant. [BINARY_DATA_REMOVED] The [product_name] has an integrated web server. Earlier versions only have basic web server capabilities, while newer versions come with extended functionality.
I'm sorry, but I don't have your level of expertise. If you could kindly assist me further and explain how to solve my issue, I would appreciate it. Otherwise, thank you anyway.
This discussion is closed because the question was posted twice. The second thread regarding command from an iPhone app is published in another conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are exploring how to use a mobile phone, specifically an iPhone, to remotely control a [product_name] module over a local network. The conversation highlights uncertainty about connecting a mobile device directly to the module and about leveraging the built-in web server features for remote operation. There is a clear need for more user-friendly guidance to support mobile integration with the hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to conveniently manage the outputs of a [product_name] via a custom app or mobile interface on an iPhone within the local network.
